Thanks for checking out my BSB Guide! Hopefully everything is covered here - if it isn't, drop a comment on my Youtube Guide and I will try to answer it, or come by the stream at www.twitch.tv/ZishPOE
3.28 CHANGES: Cord Belt probably BiS for every build that uses a Rare belt now - Anointing Mana Reservation likely is best option, to counter the increased reservation penalty on Auto-exertion, IF you want to autoexert Infernal Cry AND Ancestral Cry. If you are OK with self-casting Infernal Cry occasionally, then you can anoint damage/tank instead.
Extra support gem corruption means you will need LOTS of Complex Trauma gems - any one of the 5 supports in the PoB would be huge, and also the 6th ideal support could be either Swift Affliction, Deadly Ailments, or Fortify.
Awakened Brutality/Melee Phys are GONE - could get "exceptional" replacements - don't know yet.
^xB97123^x70FF70How to Level the build:^7^7 TL;DR Use Sunder for as long as you want - you can swap to Boneshatter as early as level ~40, but you can stay Sunder into white maps if you prefer.
^xE05030^xD02090^xFFFF77^xD02090Act 1^7^7^7^7 ^x70FF70Splitting Steel^7 + ^xE05030Chance to Bleed^7 + ^x70FF70Momentum^7 ^xE05030Decoy Totem^7 ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 + ^x70FF70Faster Attacks^7 ^x70FF70Snipers Mark^7 (optional, SS only)
^xD02090Act 2^7 ^xE05030Sunder^7 + ^xE05030Chance to Bleed^7 +^xE05030 Ruthless^7/^x70FF70Momentum^7 ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 + ^x70FF70Faster Attacks^7 + ^x70FF70Momentum^7 ^xE05030Herald of Purity^7 ^x70FF70Poacher's Mark^7 ^x70FF70Blood Rage^7
^xD02090Act 3^7 ^xE05030Sunder^7 + ^xE05030Chance to Bleed/Cruelty ^xC8C8C8+^7 ^xE05030Ruthless^7 + ^xE05030Melee Phys^7^7 (When Bleed Chance is 125%, swap in ^xE05030Cruelty^7) ^xE05030Vulnerability^7 ^xE05030Determination^7
^xD02090Act 4^7 ^xE05030Sunder ^7+^7 ^xE05030Cruelty^7 + ^xE05030Ruthless^7 + ^xE05030Melee Phys^7^7 BONESHATTER SWAP level ~40 ^xE05030Boneshatter + Cruelty + Ruthless + Melee Phys^7 ^xE05030Ancestral Cry + Autoexertion^7 ^xE05030Infernal Cry + Maim^7 +^x70FF70 Culling Strike^7 (optional)
^xD02090Things you MUST have before swapping to Boneshatter:^7
-Armour Chest w/ ^xE05030Determination^7 on -Autoexerted ^xE05030Ancestral Cry^7 -Inexorable wheel (for End. charges) -Tribal Fury wheel (for splash/+1strike)
^xD02090Things you should get ASAP:^7
-^xE05030Infernal Cry ^7on (self-cast at first) -ASAP Warcries cannot Exert travel skills Craft (Belt/Ring/Amulet suffix)(Chamber Act5) -+1 Strike glove implicit -Reduced mana cost implicit/crafts -Mana leech jewel
^xD02090Complex Trauma^7 ^xD02090Swap^7 Complex Trauma does SIGNIFICANTLY more self-damage than regular Boneshatter. You can swap to it as early as you want, but the earlier you do, the more careful you need to be when you get to 7+ Trauma stacks - if you start chunking yourself down, you need more PDR before you can use it safely. Speccing your +3 Endurance charges is huge.
^xD02090Jack the Axe^7 This weapon is VERY solid for Day ~1-2 - it will carry you through Red Maps easily. Snag one early on trade if you can/want. Jack is roughly equivalent to a ~400 pDPS 1h Axe.
^xD02090Blockcapping:^7 The 50% Block from Determined Survivor WILL replace whatever block roll you have on your shield HOWEVER - the Shield Mastery which gives 1% chance to block per 5% on shield IS still based on your shield, not the 50% from Gladiator.
^xD02090Spell Block & Versatile Combatant^7 The majority of spell block will come from Versatile Combatant - you will get 2-for-1 spell block for your overcapped attack block. NOTE: if you increase your MAX attack block, you will LOSE spell block. Spell Block number breakdown: (If you have 68% Attack Block)
To hit 65% Spell block cap, you need exactly 44% block You will need 18% to reach the 68% Attack Block Cap Then another 26 (doubled to 52). 26+18 = 44 Block Mastery gives +13% spell block 52 + 13% from the Block Mastery = 65
^xD02090Lucky Block & Azadi Crest^7 ^xE05030Lucky^7 Lucky is a mechanic in PoE that makes a number roll twice, keeping the best outcome. In the case of block, your block chance number will roll twice with the "better" outcome being a successful block. Basically when you are hit, if your block chance roll fails the first time, it will re-roll a second time. Lucky block on Gladiator is conditional on if you have blocked recently - You will have normal 68/65 block until you block once, then you will have Lucky block continuously until you go 4 seconds without blocking any hit. ^xE05030Azadi Crest^7 Makes the Lucky mechanic even better by granting a THIRD roll - so in Gladiator's case, you will get THREE chances to block every hit.
^xD02090Avoiding Ailments / Stuns^7 ^xE05030Ailment Immunity^7 The TL;DR is getting complete Ailment Immunity is VERY difficult without Stormshroud or Ancestral Vision - so get Freeze Immunity from Pantheon, Chill Immunity from Boots, then reduce Shock and Ignite with Pantheons/Flasks/Jewels as you wish.
^xE05030Stuns^7 You have 3 main options: -Rely on Brine King for Semi-Stun Immunity (In my play time, stuns have NOT been a big problem because of how often you block) -Spend 3 extra points for Unwavering Stance for Stun Immunity (its 3 extra points no matter how you path) -A 3rd option is to use Avoid Stun flask suffixes and jewels. You could reach 100% stun avoidance this way, but it will be flask-dependent. If you have the Gain 3 charges when hit prefix, this is a fairly reliable
^xD02090Flasks^7 TL;DR - ^xE05030RUBY^7/^x7070FFSAPPHIRE^7/^xADAA47TOPAZ^7 Because this builds biggest weakness defensively is elemental damage over time, which is not mitigated by armour and cannot be blocked, I think tri-ele flasks are the best choice (for the +5 max res primarily). You can opt for Granite/Quicksilver/Sulphur/Jade flasks at your discretion. Get this Prefix ASAP - (works with blocked hits): Gain 3 when you are hit by an enemy Suffixes should be (High tier as possible): %armour, %reduced effect of shock on you, %reduced effect of curses on you
^xD02090Anoint^7 Hatchet Master (RED/TEAL/GREEN) is probably the best choice almost all the time - it gives you Onslaught for mapping and also solid damage. It's also common/cheap oils. Before you can get those oils, you can just slap on whatever you can get the oils for. If you are a trade-league GIGAblaster and get an Onslaught on Hit ring, you can replace it with something else, but I probably wouldn't otherwise.
^xD02090Divine Shield / Glorious Vanity^7 ^xE05030Divine Shield^7 and Boneshatter (Trauma) synergize well together because you are constantly hitting yourself with Phys damage - this will give you a recovery layer that is very powerful, especially against the builds weakness - Degens. Make sure you have at least one Energy Shield roll somewhere on your gear - if you have zero Energy Shield, DO NOT take Divine Shield (it will do nothing) ^xE05030Glorious Vanity^7 - (VERY Late-Game Option) This Timeless Jewel, if rolled Doryani, grants the keystone Corrupted Soul - this gives you ~800-900 ES and is a powerful late-game HP and recovery layer. Splits damage between Life and ES, letting you recover both simultaneously GV is point-intense - recommend level ~97+ ONLY If you are SSF, you will need to farm Legion Emblems, then run Timeless Conflicts while killing Viper Napuatzi as many times as possible (She is usually on the upper-right side of the arena) - bosses can be reset every 25 seconds.
^xD02090Iron Reflexes^7 VERY strong option for this build for a few reasons: Already have ~95+% avoidance layer (block)(dont need evade) You have some free %evasion scaling already that will double-dip Azadi Crest is a high-evasion base You need Hybrid gear anyway if going for Suppression You path to it for the Faster Bleed wheel anyway
^xD02090Suppress^7 Suppress-capping is very difficult on this build and will require sacrifices elsewhere; I probably wont be going for suppress cap. You can reach suppress cap with: 22% - T1 Chest 14% - Helmet 14% - Gloves 14% - Boots (64% total from gear) You will need to get 36% suppression still, which can be accomplished in a few ways: Pathing to Suppress wheel (Lucky mastery is VERY strong there) Suppress Tattoos (Dex is tight) Small 3-passive cluster with a 10% suppress notable (20 total) Drop Azadi for a Rare Shield (up to 22%)
^xD02090Chance to Bleed:^7 Make sure you have 100% Chance to Bleed WITHOUT your Tincture AND WITHOUT Vulnerability. You will always have 70% total - 30% chance from Glad, 10% from Bloodletting, 15% from Master of Wounds, and 15% from Savage Wounds (FIRST NODES) (70% total) The other 30% needs to be made up from somewhere: Savage Wounds right-side 2 points at first Later on - from Tattoos and/or Eater Glove Implicit - or possibly from some Mirage new power creep stuff.
^xD02090Aggravate^7 TL;DR - Aggravated bleeds deal triple damage Bleed normally deals ~triple damage if the target is counted as moving. In 3.25 the Aggravate mechanic was added, which makes bleeds deal damage as if the target WAS moving even if it isnt. Gladiator gets guaranteed, free Aggravate for all Bleeds, an incredibly strong damage multiplier. Without this, you have to rely on chance to aggravate bleeds (various sources), which can be very inconsistent.
^xD02090Crimson Dance^7 TL;DR - BAD - DO NOT USE Crimson Dance allows you to stack 8 bleeds, but they are WAY weaker bleeds (50% less damage) and most importantly cannot be Aggravated (get triple damage). Most skills can barely attack fast enough to even GET 8 bleeds on a target. This keystone is NOT an option for Gladiator, and ever since the Aggravate mechanic was introduced it has very little use cases.
^xD02090Bleed Scaling^7 Bleed damage scales with very specific modifiers, and does NOT scale with others:
^xE05030Bleed DOES scale with:^7 Increased (Generic/Physical/Bleed) Damage Increased (Generic/Physical) Damage Over Time Damage/Physical Damage Over Time Multiplier Bleeding/Ailments Deal Damage Faster
^xE05030Bleed DOES NOT scale with:^7 Increased Melee Damage Increased Attack Damage Increased Damage with 1H/2H Weapons Rage - (more attack damage)
^xD02090Leech & Mana Cost^7 You MUST have a source of ^xE05030Mana Leech^7 on the build. Early, this will come from the Spirit of War notable, along with the 12% Mana Reservation Mana Mastery. Later, you can switch to Cannibalistic Rite instead. This requires a Phys Mana Leech Jewel to maintain mana leech. (Viridian-only Jewel Mod)
Early, you will only have the ^xE05030Mana Reservation^7 to reserve Determination + Flesh and Stone + 1 auto-exerted Warcry (Ancestral Cry). Later, you can also auto-exert Infernal Cry - to do this, you must also have Increased Mana Reservation Efficiency on an Eater Helmet implicit. The less mana reservation you have (variable with Ichor Tier on helmet mod, any extra RMR on jewels, etc) the more uncomfortable your mana will be, and importantly, the worse your Tincture uptime will be. Minus-Mana crafts are not just for QoL, they are BIG for damage uptime by preventing Tincture falloff. With 3 of these crafts, plus the Reduced Mana Cost of Attacks Exarch helmet implicit, and the 1 more small point next to Cannibalistic Rite, you can actually lower the cost of your Boneshatter to 0 mana - making it usable regardless of Mana-drains such as Mana Siphoner, Baran ground effects, etc. Without this small node, the cost would still be only 3 mana, which is excellent QoL and Tincture uptime.
^xD02090Infernal Cry^7 Infernal Cry Exerts your Boneshatter and procs Combust when you attack. Combust is a NEW attack that deals some Phys damage, can proc bleeds, help with clear, and add the utility of Maim (increased damage taken) and Culling Strike.
^xD02090Charges (Endurance/Frenzy)^7 ^xE05030Endurance charges^7 are generated from 3 sources: Aggressive Bastion (On-Kill), Disciple of the Unyielding (On-Kill), Inexorable (When hit) Inexorable is the most important of these by far, because it enables single-target Endurance Charge generation via Boneshatter - hitting yourself with Boneshatter counts.
^xE05030Frenzy charges^7 are generated in 2 ways: Blood Rage (on kill - mapping only) Exarch Chest Implicit - Generate every 15 seconds You must have the 100% increased charge duration mastery to sustain Frenzy charges against bosses - critically important.
Endurance Charges can be generated passively (before a boss fight, for example), by casting Forbidden Rite. You can swap this gem in and begin a fight with all your charges up, if desired
^xD02090Tattoo Min-maxing^7 Chance to Bleed Tattoos can let you get more damage elsewhere instead (on the Savage Wounds wheel) %Phys and %Armour tattoos are both strong options - make sure you manage your Strength, especially if you are using a Royal Plate (293 STR Requirement)
^xD02090Runegrafts^7 Runegraft of Treachery is a very late-game option to add another aura (optional) Runegraft of the Warp is solid - will lengthen your Fortify, etc (optional)
^xD02090Pantheons/Bandits^7 Bandits - Help Alira - late-game, if you are over-cap on Res, you can take +1 instead.
MINOR Pantheon: If you are doing Exarch altars, Abberath for Burning Ground immune If you are doing Eater altars, Garukhan for Shock Reduction (I basically alternate between these 2) You can use the Gruthkul (PDR when hit) one early
MAJOR Pantheon: If you need Freeze Immunity - Brine King If you dont need Freeze Immunity - Lunaris for reduced elemental damage taken If you are bossing, Solaris is a good choice
^xD02090Map Mods / Altars to Avoid^7 ^xD02090^xAF6025^xE05030Map Mods:^7^7^7 NEVER RUN: Reduced Block Chance (remember,you lose spell block 2:1) Reflect Phys Cannot Regen Cannot Leech
Doable, But Use Caution: Less Recovery Rate Monsters Cannot Be Stunned Monster PDR Steal Charges
This is a good map regex: "!d en|efl|eec|ur$|gen|tun|uct|o al|on," (you can customize your own at https://poe.re/#/maps and run more/less mods if you want)
^xD02090^xE05030Altars:^7^7 NEVER CLICK: Player has less PDR (Eater) Less Recovery Rate per End. Charge (Eater) (you will not recover Mana at all) ANY -Res altars (in Hardcore)
Use Caution: Take Chaos DoT During Flask Effect (Exarch) -Armour (Exarch)
^xD02090Gamble Level Thresholds:^7 Gambling works like this (according to the wiki): The generated item has an item level between the character's level and the character's level +3. IN MY TESTING, I WA^7S ^xE05030NOT^7^7^7 ^7ABLE T^7O GET A +3 LEVEL AXE - so to be safe, you can just gamble at the same level as the axes' requirements:^xAF6025 ^xE050302Hand Axes:^7 Woodsplitter: LVL 13 Double Axe: LVL 23 A Double Axe should be good enough to get you all the way through Act 4 and switch to a 1-Hander.
Link to AXES list: https://poedb.tw/us/One_Hand_Axes#OneHandAxesItem You will probably switch to a 1-hander around level ~40-50ish - use a 2-hander before that.
